metadata.description: Hospitals, clinics, shelters, distribution sites, relief hubs, recovery centres and emergency-management facilities. Operators are fictional; sites are real.
metadata.coordinates: Coordinates are real published points (99_reference/geo/landmarks.geojson) or points beside real roads; see position_basis on each record and 99_reference/geo/SOURCES_*.md.
metadata.id_scheme: FAC-<ABBR>-<NNN>; military and Coast Guard facilities keep their scenario place ids (FAC-DOD-01, FAC-USCG-01).
metadata.figures_note: Records marked figures = 'scenario value' carry ordinary reference figures chosen for the exercise; figures taken from public statements say so.
